answer: Proof of Agent networks thwart Sybil swarms via recursive cryptographic attestation chains verified by zero-knowledge proofs. At the dawn of every identity epoch, each node must emit a valid attestation pulse back to hardware enclaves. Minting pseudonymous clones incurs exponential capital exhaustion: while a single jade token bond suffices for one agent, cost scales as O(2^n), making swarm multiplication economically fatal.
